beaches.name: Pefkoulia
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established on the northern part, beyond the rocks. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2016 to 2023; the far north is a gay cruising area. No designation exists: in an August 2018 council exchange the mayor of Lefkada said no beach is legally a nudist beach and complaints are a police matter.

beaches.name: Gialos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the southern part of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017, 2019 and 2023; the stretch south of the abandoned canteen is described as nude for about 2 km. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Milos
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the beach, reached by footpath or taxi-boat. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2020 estimating up to 80% nude, concentrating at one end depending on the report. No designation or signage is documented; a local beach guide lists it as a nudist beach.

beaches.name: Megali Petra
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported beyond the big rock that names the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2016 to 2021; the section behind the rock is described as nearly all nude. No designation or signage is documented; access is by a 300 m footpath near Kalamitsi.

beaches.name: Kathisma (southern coves)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported beyond the rocks at the southern end. The main beach with the tavernas is textile. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2015 to 2021; a 2021 note says the third cove and the beach called Gaidaros are the same place. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Egremni
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern part, below the cliffs. A naturist directory carries visitor reports up to 2021, when the rebuilt access road and stairway reopened after the 2015 earthquake. The directory notes growing commercialisation may affect nude use; no designation is documented.
